resources.string: Choose the account for this bot. Existing conversations keep their original accounts.

New private bot conversations will use this account. Bots you previously contacted will continue using their original accounts. This isolates accounts; it does not make you anonymous or revoke information already shared. Group, inline, attachment-menu and authentication interactions keep their own account.
The bot privacy account is unavailable. Select another account or disable the feature, then open the bot again. No message was sent.

Could not safely choose an account for this bot. Check your connection and open the bot again. If this chat was already open when you changed the setting, reopen it before sending. No message was sent.
Account checked. Tap Send again to send your message.
Ask which account to use for each new private bot conversation. Existing conversations keep their original accounts.
Choosing an account does not make you anonymous or revoke information already shared. Group, inline, attachment-menu and authentication interactions keep their own account.
